grantcardone on October 20, 2026: "It was an honor and a privilege to be at the National Archives for the premiere of @sbagov Million Dollar Pitch🇺🇸

Small businesses are the backbone of our economy. They create jobs, fuel innovation, strengthen communities, and give entrepreneurs the opportunity to turn their vision into reality. When small businesses win, America wins.

My mission is to help business owners think bigger, unlock their full potential, and get the resources, exposure, and opportunities they need to scale their businesses and achieve extraordinary success.

I believe every entrepreneur has the potential to build something great. My goal is to help them break through limitations, grow beyond what they thought possible, and turn their ambitions into reality.

Because when we invest in entrepreneurs, we invest in the future of America. 

I would love to help any business owner looking to reach the next level with a free ticket to my 10X Business Summit this weekend. Comment SUMMIT to claim. 

Be great".
